chapter: Las Vegas, Sinatra and later years
title: Cal-Neva Lodge and Tahoe: Mavis Rivers and Jackie and Roy
summary: They played summers at Sinatra's Cal-Neva, shared bills with Mavis Rivers and Jackie and Roy, playing Goodman and Sinatra music.
